name: NUMBERS_TRUTH_WIRING_20261110
comment: ANCHOR: NUMBERS_TRUTH_WIRING_20261110 — LQ-20261107-1726, the operator's 2026-11-09 19:00 ET instruction to
promote the numbers-truth lane live 'and make sure the alerting is turned on'. scripts/numbers_truth_audit.py
now feeds its own findings (list M) to scripts/lib/numbers_truth_strikes.run() on --apply, after the receipt,
with the engine's state file under the lane's state root; a dry run never calls the engine. The D34 critical
page (Telegram + email + every Google Fi text line) is reached ONLY by the codes named in
config/numbers_truth_heal.json page_codes — a config list, not a literal — and every other code is a
strike/ticket/FINDING record with no text, Telegram or email (the escalation intent is gated with the page).
A clear reaches a channel only for a ticket that was paged. known_disagreement is shipped EMPTY: an entry is
operator-approved, carries its reason and expires fail-closed on its own date. Hermetic: a synthetic
39-finding replay over four simulated hours, a throwaway state root, injected senders; the 1713 guard would
raise if a real sender were reached.
